mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO pisces_event_inbox (inbox_id, experiment_id, visitor_id, group_id, event_kind, event_type, event_name, scene, client_event_id, idempotency_key, properties_json, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, locked_by, locked_until, last_error, event_time, accepted_at, processed_at) VALUES (#{entity.inboxId}, #{entity.experimentId}, #{entity.visitorId}, #{entity.groupId}, #{entity.eventKind}, #{entity.eventType}, #{entity.eventName}, #{entity.scene}, #{entity.clientEventId}, #{entity.idempotencyKey}, #{entity.propertiesJson}, #{entity.status}, #{entity.retryCount}, #{entity.nextRetryAt}, #{entity.lockedBy}, #{entity.lockedUntil}, #{entity.lastError}, #{entity.eventTime}, #{entity.acceptedAt}, #{entity.processedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE pisces_event_inbox SET status = 'DONE', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, processed_at = #{processedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE inbox_id = #{inboxId}

UPDATE pisces_event_inbox SET status = 'RETRY', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE inbox_id = #{inboxId}

UPDATE pisces_event_inbox SET status = 'DEAD', retry_count = #{retryCount}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, processed_at = #{processedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE inbox_id = #{inboxId}
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(1) AS event_count FROM pisces_event_inbox WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} GROUP BY status
SELECT MIN(accepted_at) FROM pisces_event_inbox WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'RETRY')
mapper.update: UPDATE pisces_event_inbox SET status = 'RETRY', retry_count = 0, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, processed_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE experiment_id = #{experimentId} AND status = 'DEAD'
